title: More adjustable semantic matching
summary:
A small garden day: tunable semantic matching, clearer issue guidance, and fewer stray commas in the machinery.

Semantic threshold handling is now variable and covered by tests, giving matching behavior a clearer, more tunable foundation.

The issue-making guidance was simplified into a clearer document, while small typo and style fixes removed a little more repository grit.

highlights.title: Multilingual Caching
highlights.text: Upgraded semantic cache to the `bge-m3` model for smarter prompt matching across languages.

highlights.title: Community Showcase
highlights.text: Welcomed 8 new projects including [Island AI](https://islandai.app) and [Botzy](https://botzy.hexabiz.com.pk) to the ecosystem.
